about.title: Xeno Trunks.
about.text: Not the Trunks you know. Mine’s a Time Patroller from a timeline you haven’t seen yet. Since 2022 I’ve been scripting custom Parallel Quests for Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2: what-if stories like Yamcha’s Resolve and Vegeta’s Humiliation, boss fights like Banana Blitz Showdown, collabs like The Heroes Marvellous Show with BBVenom, and quests built with other creators, like the Goku Day Pack with BlazingSpirit.

points.text: Quest design and scripting: stages, enemies, allies, dialogue, win and lose conditions.
Cinematic moments: transformations, mid-fight events and custom cutscenes.
Trailers and thumbnails for every release.
Fan-made and free to play. Every asset author gets credited.
